description: Execute an arbitrary RouterOS console command via SSH. Guarded by an allow/deny policy (built-in deny list blocks destructive commands; tighten via cmdAllow in routers.yaml or MIKROMCP_CMD_ALLOW). Prefer dedicated tools (reboot, etc.) where available. Output capped at 4000 characters.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

dryRun.description: Preview the command without executing (validates allow/deny policy only)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

name: run_command
title: Run Command
